provenance.note: Both CETPs discharge to the sea, not to a river. We have not found a regulator's monthly per-sample record like Surat's GEMI series for either plant. For JN Pharma City, APPCB's report to the NGT in OA 141/2023 (SZ) annexes CSIR-NIO analyses of treated effluent from the CETP's MBR outlet tank, commissioned by the operator, for samples of 14.09.2023, 12.10.2023 and 21.11.2023 (DO, BOD3, pH, nutrients and suspended matter against CPCB standards, pdf pp. 228, 245, 262), plus bio-assay-only reports for January to May 2024; these are not yet carried here. APPCB publishes counts of release samples that did not meet marine discharge standards, carried here as published with overlapping periods kept separate. sample_dates and parameters are empty because no regulator per-sample series has been found.

_note: Every norm here is APPCB's marine discharge standard for the plant's consented outfall. For the JN Pharma City CETP, APPCB states that a release which does not meet it is held back and re-treated, so those counts are of samples, not of discharges to the sea.
